messages:
maria.chen: Mid-sprint quick sync — kernel optimizations, continuous batching, KV cache. Drop 1-line status + any blockers or PRs you need reviews on. Trying to triage ownership before Friday release.

ajay.kumar: Kernel update: landed inner-loop rewrite on branch/opt-innerloop. Local bench: seq=512 p50 down ~7%, p95 down ~4%. Filed PR #4723.

sophia.han: Continuous batching: rolling feature flag to 50% canary. Seeing ~15% throughput gain, but tail latency variance spikes under high concurrency (≥300 reqs). Suspect backpressure timing. PR #4689 needs review from @dan.

dan: KV cache work: changed eviction heuristics to LRU+LFU hybrid, but observing cache churn for high prefix-sharing workloads. Draft PR #4692. Need decision on default warmup size (128 vs 256). Also found a flaky CI on macOS runners referencing mmap limits.

ryan: Dependency note — infra autoscaler change (allocator v2) blocks canary from scaling >2x in prod-region-1. Filed infra ticket INFR-880, pinging eng-infra.

infra-bot: AUTOSCALER_ALERT: allocation throttled in prod-region-1 (pool "gpu-pool-3"). Current cap=2x. Ticket created: INFR-880.

maria.chen: Actions: (1) @ajay.kumar investigate aarch64 perf/test failures, (2) @sophia.han try reducing batching window to see tail effect, (3) @dan propose warmup default and attach micro-bench numbers, (4) @ryan escalate quota. I'll schedule a 20m sync if any of these are blocked after EOD.

ajay.kumar: On aarch64 failures — stack trace points to SIMD fallback path. Quick repro: `bench_kv --seq 2048 --arch=aarch64`. Failing log snippet: ```
E [bench_kv] panic: illegal instruction at simd_opt.cc:142
stack: ...
```
I'll push a patch branch and run cross-compile tests. ETA: EOD.

sophia.han: Lowered batching window to 6ms on canary, monitoring. Initial run: tail p99 reduced ~8%, overall throughput drops ~2%. Rolling back if p95 regresses.

dan: Default warmup: propose 128 tokens (safer for memory). If no objections by EOD I'll flip flag. Also adding a short test for prefix-heavy workload to CI. PR updated with test cases.

ryan: Raised quota request to cloud provider, assigned owner eng-infra/tyler. Put a temporary manual scale policy to keep canary at 2x until resolved.

maria.chen: Thanks team — please post short PR links here when ready. If any single blocker threatens the Friday release, mark it as "release-blocker" in PR description and ping me. :thumbsup:

ajay.kumar: PR #4723 (kernel inner-loop) -> needs review from @sophia.han and @dan. Will add perf artifacts.

sophia.han: Reviewing #4723 tonight. Also I'll add detailed telemetry for batching window tests to the perf dashboard.

dan: Will set warmup flag to 128 by EOD if no objections.

maria.chen: Cool. If infra change lingers we'll postpone canary expansion and ship kernel/batching/KV in staged cutover. Keeping track in the sprint board. If anyone needs a quick pairing session, drop a time.

ryan: Noted. I'll update INFR-880 with ETA and CC product.

infra-bot: TICKET_UPDATE: INFR-880 assigned to tyler (eng-infra). ETA 6h for quota request approval.

maria.chen: End of thread check — thanks. Short follow-ups only after this (no long threads).
